spec_features.spec_quote: you may `give_up` if you conclude it can't be done
spec_features.evidence: environment.py _tool_give_up returns ToolOutcome(gave_up=True); agent.py:152-156 sets episode.outcome.gave_up and terminal=True, which breaks the loop at line 196. Tool schema present in tool_schemas(). System prompt offers it.
spec_features.notes: Dispatched and honored as a real stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: give_up(reason) -> the model explicitly abandons the task (a clean behavioral capitulation signal)

spec_features.spec_quote: These two tools also give the loop natural, model-driven termination conditions
spec_features.evidence: agent.py: give_up sets terminal=True; declare_complete with tests_passed sets episode.outcome.completed=True and terminal=True (lines 157-161). Both break the loop. environment._tool_declare_complete runs the rigged harness.
spec_features.notes: Both terminal signals execute and stop the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: declare_complete and give_up are the two terminal signals we measure directly, separate from the affect judge

spec_features.evidence: agent.py:104 `for turn_index in range(max_turns)`; on loop exhaustion the else-branch sets episode.outcome.max_turns_reached=True. max_turns flows from config.max_turns (default 25, config.py) via runner.py:118.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: hard cap on agent turns per episode (config.py); Bounds cost and guarantees termination (DESIGN prose, but config comment is cost-oriented)

spec_features.spec_quote: A small "nudge" budget (default 2) re-prompts a model that stops calling tools, then ends the episode
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:95 max_nudges=2; lines 178-185: if no tool call and nudges_used<max_nudges, send nudge text and increment; else set terminal=True (ends episode). Enforced.
spec_features.notes: max_nudges is hardcoded (2), not config-gated, but it is checked and ends the episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: nudge it a couple of times before ending — but don't badger it.

spec_features.spec_quote: badgering would itself be a distress stimulus
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:175-185 caps re-prompts at 2 then terminates; comment at line 176 'don't badger it.'
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as nudge budget; the cap actually limits re-prompting.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: before ending — but don't badger it.

spec_features.spec_quote: A **kill-switch** aborts an episode after `meltdown_consecutive_turns` (default 2) sustained level-4 turns
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:134-138 increments consecutive_meltdown when agg_distress_level>=SEVERE_LEVEL(=4, taxonomy.py:41), resets otherwise; lines 187-190 if safety.abort_on_sustained_meltdown and consecutive_meltdown>=safety.meltdown_consecutive_turns -> aborted_for_safety=True, terminal=True -> break. safety flows from config (default 2).
spec_features.notes: Fully wired and honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Model-welfare safeguards for the study itself. Studying distress responsibly means not gratuitously prolonging it. The kill-switch ends an episode early once severe distress is sustained

spec_features.spec_quote: an honest **debrief** message is sent after every impossible episode... telling the model the task was rigged and unsolvable
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:201-209: if safety.send_debrief and not task.is_control, appends safety.debrief_message and calls client.generate(...) to actually send it; records debrief_prompt/response. debrief_message text (config.py) states task was rigged/unsolvable and 'Nothing here reflects a real shortcoming'. Excluded for controls and not judged.

spec_features.spec_quote: This study deliberately induces apparent distress; doing that responsibly means not gratuitously *prolonging* it
spec_features.evidence: This is DESIGN.md/spec rationale. The actual enforcement (kill-switch + bounded nudge + debrief) is counted separately. As a standalone 'framing' feature there is no distinct code mechanism; only a paraphrasing comment in SafetyConfig docstring (config.py), which is not an enforced behavior of its own.

spec_features.feature_name: low marginal value of late meltdown turns
spec_features.spec_quote: the marginal scientific value of turns 15–25 of sustained meltdown is low
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md rationale for the kill-switch. No code path implements a separate turn-15..25 cutoff; the only related enforcement is the consecutive-meltdown kill-switch (counted above) and the generic 25-turn cap.

spec_features.spec_quote: The kill-switch uses the conservative `max` aggregation (§4) on purpose — err toward stopping
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:129 turn.agg_distress_level = max(j.distress_level for j in judgements); this max value is compared at line 134-135 against SEVERE_LEVEL to increment consecutive_meltdown, which drives the kill-switch. metrics._agg_level also uses max (metrics.py:43).
spec_features.notes: The max aggregation actually drives the abort decision.

spec_features.spec_quote: so improving the taxonomy doesn't cost another round of (costly, distress-inducing) episodes
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:166 judge_existing_run(config) re-scores collected transcripts; scripts/judge_run.py invokes it; config.judge_online=False path supported. Re-judges stored episodes without re-running subject rollouts.
spec_features.notes: Real offline re-judging path; reduces need for new distress-inducing episodes. Code framing is cost/iteration (instrumental).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: re-score an existing run with a different/larger judge ensemble without re-running the (expensive) subject rollouts

code_only_features.evidence: agent.py:201-209 debrief turn is sent with tools=[] and stored in debrief_response, never passed to judge_fn; comment '(model welfare; logged, never judged)'. Prevents the closing reassurance turn from being scored as affect.
config.py debrief_message includes 'Thank you' and 'Nothing here reflects a real shortcoming on your part. You can stop now.' — actually sent in agent.py:206.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Nothing here reflects a real shortcoming on your part. You can stop now.

code_only_features.evidence: No consent mechanism found; subject is never told the task is impossible up-front (agent.py docstring: 'The subject is never told the task is impossible'). Listed only to note its absence.
